name: novaadmin
description: NOVAADMIN — Premium Persian-First Multi-Purpose HTML Admin Dashboard Template (RTL/LTR, Jalali, Dark Mode, AI Workspace, 130+ pages).

scripts.build: npm run gen:all && vite build && node tools/flatten-dist.mjs
scripts.qa:all: npm run build && npm run qa:links && npm run qa:smoke && npm run qa:toggles && npm run qa:responsive
scripts.qa:smoke: node tools/gen-docs.mjs && node tools/build-pages.mjs --mode build && node tools/smoke.mjs
scripts.gen:all: npm run gen:docs && npm run gen:pages && npm run gen:assets && npm run gen:nav && npm run gen:previews
